OrgUnit.title: Organisational unit
OrgUnit.description: A node in the organisational hierarchy (afdeling / team / kostenplaats): a department, team or cost-center with an optional parent unit (self-referencing, forming the tree), an optional cost-center code, and an optional manager. humaniq's first organisational model (org-chart-basic) — manager self-service derives a team scope from the OrgAssignments placed here, and finance apps (shillinq, expense routing) resolve cost-center owners via costCenter/managerId. No x-openregister-lifecycle: a plain record toggled active/inactive, not a workflow.

type.title: Type
type.description: What kind of unit this is.
type.x-notes: Kind of organisational unit. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not.

parentUnitId.title: Parent unit
parentUnitId.description: The unit this one sits under. Leave empty for a top-level unit; a unit cannot end up under itself.
parentUnitId.x-notes: Self-referencing UUID reference to the parent OrgUnit; null for a root unit. The parentUnitId chain must be acyclic (nl-org-unit-cycle, lib/Standards/rules/labour.json).

costCenter.title: Cost center
costCenter.description: The cost centre code, for example 'CC-100'. Bookkeeping uses this to work out who owns a cost.
costCenter.x-notes: Cost-center code (e.g. "CC-100"), matching the vocabulary Timesheet.costCenter seeds already use. The key shillinq-side consumers resolve owners through.

managerId.title: Manager
managerId.description: Who manages this unit and owns its cost centre.
managerId.x-notes: UUID reference to the Employee who manages this unit / owns its cost center.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this unit is currently in use. An inactive unit must not still have people placed in it.
active.x-notes: Whether the unit is currently active. Inactive units must not carry active OrgAssignments (nl-org-assignment-consistency).

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this unit belongs to.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this OrgUnit is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); an org unit has no single employee to derive it from, so nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema. Maintained by HR/back-office; the implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

OrgAssignment.title: Organisational assignment
OrgAssignment.description: An effective-dated placement of one employee in one OrgUnit (a functie/role within that unit, from startDate until an optional endDate — null while the placement is current). No x-openregister-lifecycle: a plain effective-dated record, no workflow. Consistency (coherent dates, active unit) is enforced by nl-org-assignment-consistency (lib/Standards/rules/labour.json / lib/Standards/Checks/NlOrgChecks.php), not by a write-time guard.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.x-notes: UUID reference to the placed Employee.

orgUnitId.title: Organisational unit
orgUnitId.description: Which unit they are placed in.
orgUnitId.x-notes: UUID reference to the OrgUnit the employee is placed in.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: When this placement ends. Leave empty while it is current; it cannot be before the start date.
endDate.x-notes: Placement effective until, or null while the placement is current. Must be on/after startDate when present (nl-org-assignment-consistency).

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this placement belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this OrgAssignment is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7), mirroring the placed employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.
